"""
Decompressor for the ".cz" format produced by /workspace/crush.

Format reverse-engineered from the binary (symbols: main, add_char_to_map,

    map = calloc-ish zeroed array of 255 qword head pointers (indices 0..254)
    i = 0

add_char_to_map(map, c, idx): append node{idx, NULL} to map[c]'s list.

serialize_and_output(map): for i in 0..254 (0xfe inclusive):
    fwrite(&list_len(&map[i]), 8, 1, stdout)   # count of positions
    for each node: fwrite(&node->offset, 8, 1, stdout)   # only the offset

So the on-disk layout is, for byte value v = 0 .. 254 (255 buckets total):
    uint64 count_v                      (little endian)
    uint64 offset[count_v]              (little endian, ascending order)

Byte value 0xff is never serialized (the loops stop at 0xfe), so a 0xff byte in
the input cannot be represented / would corrupt the compressor's map; the
plaintext here contains only bytes 0x00..0xfe.

Decompression simply places value v at every recorded offset.
"""

import struct
import sys


def decompress(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    off = 0
    out = bytearray()
    for value in range(255):  # byte values 0x00 .. 0xfe
        if off + 8 > len(data):
            raise ValueError("truncated file: no count for bucket %d" % value)
        (count,) = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, off)
        off += 8
        need = count * 8
        if off + need > len(data):
            raise ValueError("truncated file: bucket %d wants %d offsets" % (value, count))
        positions = struct.unpack_from("<%dQ" % count, data, off)
        off += need
        for pos in positions:
            if pos >= len(out):
                out.extend(b"\x00" * (pos + 1 - len(out)))
            out[pos] = value
    if off != len(data):
        sys.stderr.write("warning: %d trailing bytes ignored\n" % (len(data) - off))
    return bytes(out)


def main() -> int:
    src = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "message.txt.cz"
    dst = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "decompressed.txt"
    with open(src, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    plain = decompress(data)
    with open(dst, "wb") as f:
        f.write(plain)
    sys.stderr.write("wrote %s (%d bytes)\n" % (dst, len(plain)))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
